rules: Exact text preferred; otherwise whitespace and NO./SF-prefix typography only. Internal hyphens, numeric digits and SMART/color/size suffixes are preserved. Only explicit NO. 089 COMBO / NO. 089-COMBO alias is allowed, verified against the V3 filename and resistance tube set identity. Ambiguous/missing models are not substituted.

items.matchMethod: verified NO. 089 COMBO / NO. 089-COMBO source-filename alias
